title.rendered: Threat Actors Exploiting Microsoft 365 Power Pages Misconfigurations to Target Financial Services Firms

excerpt.rendered: The DFPI is warning registered investment advisers and broker-dealers about a significant security threat involving misconfigured Microsoft Power Pages portals that can allow unauthorized access to firm data stored in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).

title.rendered: The Job Interview Malware Trap

excerpt.rendered: Consumers, particularly those who are seeking employment, should be aware of a scam in which attackers impersonate employers to trick applicants into downloading malicious software.

title.rendered: DFPI Warns Homeowners About Home Equity “Investment” Risks

excerpt.rendered: Although HEIs may appear flexible, they are complex agreements that can lead to significant or unexpected costs.

title.rendered: Imposter Email Misusing DFPI Employee Identity to Demand Licensee Response

excerpt.rendered: A DFPI licensee recently reported receiving an email appearing to be from a DFPI employee. The email message referenced a supposed complaint received by DFPI from a consumer and demanded a response from the DFPI licensee within seven days.

title.rendered: Individual Falsely Posing as a Licensed Investment Adviser Representative

excerpt.rendered: The DFPI has received information that an individual is contacting consumers through text messages and messaging platforms, such as Telegram and WhatsApp, while falsely claiming to be Douglas Boneparth, a licensed Investment Adviser representative.

title.rendered: WhatsApp Investment Groups Falsely Posing as a California-licensed Broker-dealer

excerpt.rendered: The DFPI has received information that two WhatsApp investment groups, Freckie Capital and FRK Strategic Partner VIP3, are falsely posing as licensed broker-dealers, and convincing consumers to download the software application Bosonic (“App”).

title.rendered: WhatsApp Investment Group called “Sofi Investment Group” Posing as a California-licensed Investment Adviser

title.rendered: WhatsApp Investment Group called “VIP Guidance Group” Posing as a California-licensed Investment Adviser

excerpt.rendered: An individual calling himself Professor Jake Civiello is falsely posing as a licensed investment adviser. He runs a WhatsApp group called VIP Guidance Group, which is NOT connected to any licensed investment adviser or broker-dealer in CA.
